resources.string: You have the latest version of this channel.

You are on the newest build of this channel.
This phone is ahead of this channel (%1$s): it rejoins it at the channel’s next release. Android never installs an older version over a newer one.
Alpha builds arrive as they are written and nobody else has run them yet. Coming back to beta is not immediate: the phone waits until a beta is newer than the alpha it has.
It downloads and installs by itself.
Allow this app to install unknown apps so it can update itself.
The token can’t read the repository (expired or without access): updates are paused until you replace it.

There is not enough free space. Free some up and it will try again.
